extracted.intended_audience: PI/sponsor and contracted CROs/assay providers (grant applicant and reviewers; project managers arranging non-GLP ADME studies)
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed service/specification document for non-GLP ADME assays (plasma protein binding, microsomal clearance, CYP inhibition, plasma stability) including procedures, sample requirements, deliverables, turnaround times, documentation and fee schedules. Intended to define expectations between sponsor and contract research organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — Scope of Service
rubrics_metrics.description: To assess the protein binding of compounds in mouse and human plasma using a rapid equilibrium dialysis (RED) device (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the assay objective and the device/approach to be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — General Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Test compounds spiked into plasma to 5 µM, triplicate aliquots added to RED chambers with PBS in white chambers; sealed and incubated 4 hours at 37°C with shaking. Warfarin used as positive control. After incubation, chambers analyzed by LC-MS/MS and percent free/bound determined using peak area ratios to internal standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies sample concentration, replicate number, incubation conditions, control compound, analytical method (LC‑MS/MS), and calculation approach (peak area ratios).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — Sample & Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must provide molecular weights (formula weights and exact mass), sufficient compound amounts, stability information (light, temperature, solvents) if available, safety information for handling, and solubility information if available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List of mandatory/expected compound metadata and material needs for the assay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — Deliverable
rubrics_metrics.description: A Microsoft Excel summary report including raw data, methodology, calculated percent bound, and percent recovery values will be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliverable format (Excel) and required contents (raw data, methods, calculated metrics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — Turnaround Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Report will be delivered within 7 business days from receipt of the compounds and any additional items specific to the assay that need to be sourced externally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines delivery SLA tied to receipt of materials and any external sourcing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — Documentation/Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Data from this non-GLP study will be preserved for 1 year after submission of the results to the Sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies data retention period for non-GLP assay data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Protein Binding — Fee Schedule / Costing
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost of plasma protein binding analysis is quoted per compound. (Tables list number of compounds per year and associated costs.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fee is per compound; budget tables provided for Year 1–3 breakdown (specific numeric costs appear in the full fee table).

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability (Intrinsic Clearance) — Scope of Service
rubrics_metrics.description: To assess the relative metabolic stability (intrinsic clearance) of compounds using mouse, rat, canine and human liver microsomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines species panels and overall objective for the microsomal intrinsic clearance assay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability — General Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Test compounds at 0.5 µM incubated with 0.5 mg/mL liver microsomes and an NADPH-regenerating system in potassium phosphate buffer (pH 7.4). Aliquots taken at 0, 5, 15, 30, 45 minutes and quenched with acetonitrile containing internal standard; controls without cofactor measured. Samples analyzed by LC-MS/MS; intrinsic clearance (CLint) determined from first-order elimination constant by nonlinear regression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies concentration, microsomal protein, cofactor, time points, quench, analytical method and data analysis method for CLint estimation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability — Sample & Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must provide molecular weights (formula weights and exact mass), sufficient amounts of compounds, stability information (light, temperature, solvents) if available, safety information for handling, and solubility information if available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same compound metadata/material requirements as other assays; necessary to perform assay and interpret results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability — Deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: A Microsoft Excel summary report of intrinsic clearance (CLint), half-life (t1/2), rate constant, peak area ratios of each analyte to internal standard, and graphic profiles will be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required output metrics and formats (Excel, numeric and graphical outputs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability — Turnaround Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Report will be delivered within 7 business days from Sponsor’s approval of the study and receipt of all necessary information and assay-specific materials/reagents by Alliance Pharma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delivery SLA contingent on sponsor approval and receipt of materials/reagents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability — Documentation/Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Data from this non-GLP study will be preserved for 1 year after submission of the results to the Sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard 1-year retention for non-GLP data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metabolic Stability — Fee Schedule / Costing
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost of metabolic stability analysis using liver microsomes is quoted per compound. (Tables list species-specific microsomal clearance assays and numbers of compounds per year.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fee structure per compound per species/assay detailed in fee tables (Year 1–3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition Study — Scope of Service
rubrics_metrics.description: To evaluate the direct inhibition potential of compounds on the major human hepatic CYP3A4 isoform using pooled human liver microsomes and the isoform-specific probe substrate testosterone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies target isoform and probe substrate for single‑isoform inhibition study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition — General Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Incubations include buffer, 0.1 mg/mL microsomal protein, CYP3A4 probe substrate testosterone (12.5 μM), specific concentrations of test compounds, blank solvent or positive controls, and NADPH-regenerating solution; incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2 with shaking for 5 minutes, quench with acetonitrile/internal standard; analyze by LC-MS/MS; enzyme activity normalized to controls and expressed as percent activity; IC50 determined by nonlinear regression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies incubation constituents, substrate concentration, incubation conditions, quench and analytical/data analysis approach for IC50 determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition — Sample & Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must provide molecular weights (formula weights and exact mass), sufficient amounts of the compounds, stability information (light, temperature, solvents) if available, safety information for handling the compounds, and solubility of the compounds if available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same required compound metadata and material provisioning as other assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition — Deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: A Microsoft Excel summary report including IC50 summary tables and plots of test compound concentration versus peak area ratios will be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliverable includes numeric IC50 tables and concentration-response plots in Excel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition — Turnaround Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Report will be delivered within 8 business days from Sponsor’s approval of the study and receipt of all necessary information and assay-specific materials/reagents by Alliance Pharma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 8 business day SLA for single-isoform CYP IC50 assays, contingent on approvals/materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition — Documentation/Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Data from this non-GLP study will be preserved for 1 year after submission of the results to the Sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard 1-year retention for non-GLP CYP data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP3A4 Inhibition — Fee Schedule / Costing
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost of CYP inhibition analysis is quoted per compound, per probe substrate (one isoform-specific probe substrate). Fee table lists number of compounds per year and cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing is per compound per probe substrate (i.e., per isoform tested).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Inhibition — Full Panel (7 isoforms) Scope of Service
rubrics_metrics.description: To evaluate the direct inhibition potential of compounds on 7 major human hepatic CYP isoforms (1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 and 3A4) using pooled human liver microsomes and isoform-specific probe substrates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines multi‑isoform panel and objective for comprehensive CYP inhibition profiling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — General Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Incubations contain buffer, 0.1 mg/mL microsomal protein, isoform-specific probe substrates, test compound concentrations or controls, and NADPH-regenerating solution. Incubation durations vary by substrate (e.g., 5 minutes for midazolam; 10 minutes for phenacetin, bupropion, diclofenac, dextromethorphan; 20 minutes for amodiaquine or S-mephenytoin). Reactions quenched with acetonitrile/internal standard; analyzed by LC-MS/MS. Enzyme activity normalized to controls and inhibitory potential (IC50) determined by nonlinear regression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes specific incubation times per substrate class, analytical approach, normalization and IC50 determination method. Table of substrates, inhibitors and final concentrations provided (isoform-specific inhibitors and substrate final concentrations listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — Isoform-Specific Probe List & Concentrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of isoform-specific probe substrates and inhibitors: e.g., CYP1A2 substrate Phenacetin (35 μM) with inhibitor Fluvoxamine; CYP2B6 substrate Bupropion (50 μM) with inhibitor Clopidogrel; CYP3A4 substrate Midazolam (1.25 μM) with inhibitor Ketoconazole; etc. Final inhibitor concentration ranges and substrate concentrations are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the exact substrates, inhibitors and concentration series used for IC50 curve generation for each isoform (useful for replicability and comparability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — Sample & Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must provide molecular weights (formula weights and exact mass), sufficient amounts of the compounds, stability information (light, temperature, solvents) if available, safety information for handling the compounds, and solubility of the compounds if available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard compound information requirements repeated for full-panel testing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — Deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: A Microsoft Excel summary report including IC50 summary tables and plots of test compound concentration versus peak area ratios will be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same deliverable expectations as single-isoform but for the full panel (IC50 tables and plots for each isoform).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — Turnaround Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Report will be delivered within 8 business days from Sponsor’s approval of the study and receipt of all necessary information and assay-specific materials/reagents by Alliance Pharma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 8 business day SLA for full-panel CYP assays, contingent on approvals/materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — Documentation/Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Data from this non-GLP study will be preserved for 1 year after submission of the results to the Sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard retention requirement across assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct CYP Full Panel — Fee Schedule / Costing
rubrics_metrics.description: The cost of the full-panel CYP inhibition assay is quoted per compound (per compound, per probe substrate). Fee tables list number of compounds and associated costs across years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing structure distinguishes single‑substrate vs 7‑substrate (full panel) costs; fee tables provide yearly breakdown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Stability Studies — Scope of Service
rubrics_metrics.description: To assess the relative stability of compounds in mouse and human plasma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the assay objective for plasma stability testing across species.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Stability — General Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Test compounds will be incubated at a concentration of 1 µM in plasma samples. At 0, 15, 30, 60 and 120 minutes, aliquots removed and reactions quenched with an acetonitrile solution containing an internal standard. Samples analyzed by LC‑MS/MS and results reported as peak area ratios of analyte to internal standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies concentration, time points, quench, analytical method and output metric (peak area ratios).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Stability — Sample & Submission Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor must provide molecular weights (formula weights and exact mass), sufficient amounts of the compounds, stability information (light, temperature, solvents) if available, safety information for handling, and solubility of the compounds if available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistent compound metadata/material requirements across assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plasma Stability — Deliverables (partial)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliverables section introduced (full deliverable details follow in document).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect Excel summary with time‑course data/metrics similar to other assays (explicit deliverable wording appears later in the document).

rubrics_metrics.name: General Data Retention for Non-GLP Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Data from these non-GLP studies (plasma protein binding, metabolic stability, CYP inhibition, full-panel CYP, plasma stability) will be preserved for 1 year after submission of the results to the Sponsor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied uniformly across all listed non-GLP assays as the policy for recordkeeping.
